storybreak.stories.v1.title: The Fox's Last Ticket

prompt.trouble: the last train refuses to leave

storybreak.stories.v1.text:
Fern had one ticket and no idea where it went.
The train refused to leave until somebody told it a joke.
Fern told the joke her grandmother always told.
The train laughed all the way to the sea.

storybreak.stories.v1.title: A Pocket of Moonlight
storybreak.stories.v1.text:
Aya patched the sky with a square of blue cloth. “That should hold,” she said.
A single silver drop fell into her pocket anyway.
She kept it for the next rainy day.
